name: CTI Engineering Co., Ltd.
summary: CTI Engineering Co., Ltd. provides professional consulting services in Japan, Asia, the United Kingdom, Europe, and internationally. The company offers professional consulting services related to civil engineering and construction works, such as planning, research, design, and supervision services; disaster countermeasures for floods, droughts, tsunamis, and storm surges; watershed hydrology; seismic countermeasures for river management and coastal protection facilities; port and marine infrastructure; and mechanical and electrical equipment.
